states.unreviewed: No type-specific audit has been recorded for this profile, position and path.
states.inspected: Implementation was read; this is not an executed test.
states.passed: The named check passed for the recorded scope and artifact.
states.limited: The check covers only the explicitly recorded subset.
states.rejected: The path explicitly rejects this shape. Required delivery remains outstanding.

copied.ownership: Copied values have no retained Lean identity. Host-owned buffers may require a generated cleanup function.
copied.absence: No implicit null, omission or default conversion. Unit, Option, optional parameters and host null are separate cases.
copied.failure: Reject invalid host values before calling Lean. Preserve declared errors and unexpected-failure policy.

identity.ownership: Preserve nominal identity, runtime and generation. Generate borrow, lease, transfer and deterministic disposal from the declared lifetime.
identity.absence: A missing or disposed resource is not a null value. Optional identity values require an explicit Option mapping.
identity.failure: Reject stale, wrong-kind and wrong-runtime values. Cleanup must also run on callback re-entry and failure.

signature.ownership: Preserve every argument and result ownership transition, including cleanup after rejection or cancellation.
signature.absence: Keep parameter omission, declared defaults, Option.none and host null distinct.
signature.failure: Preserve declared errors, effect order and delivery protocol; reject unsupported signatures before producing a release.

erased.ownership: Proof-only values have no host allocation or handle.
erased.absence: Erasure is determined by elaborated Lean types, not by substituting null for an unknown type.
erased.failure: Keep runtime refinement checks and theorem provenance even when proof arguments are erased.

shapes.bounds: One inhabitant. A result with no host return value still requires an explicit argument and field mapping.
Exactly two Boolean values; do not coerce numbers or strings.
0..255; reject overflow before narrowing.
0..65535; reject overflow before narrowing.
0..4294967295, including on hosts with 32-bit signed integers.
0..18446744073709551615; no conversion through a floating-point host number.
-128..127; reject overflow before narrowing.
-32768..32767; reject overflow before narrowing.
-2147483648..2147483647; reject overflow before narrowing.
No fixed bit-width limit. Reject negative inputs and enforce documented allocation limits.
Preserve sign and magnitude without narrowing; enforce documented allocation limits.
Round to binary32. Specify NaN, infinities and signed zero; do not claim NaN payload preservation without a bit-level test.
Preserve binary64 values, NaN classification, infinities and signed zero.
Preserve Unicode scalar values and embedded NUL. Reject invalid encodings; declare byte and allocation limits.
Each byte is 0..255. Preserve zero bytes and owned result storage; declare copy limits.

shapes.meaning: An ordered, finite sequence of values.
shapes.bounds: Validate every element recursively, length and allocation limits. Array UInt32 alone does not cover Array α.
Keep none, some unit and nested options distinct; do not flatten them all to null.

shapes.meaning: A success value or a declared error value.
shapes.bounds: Preserve the success/error branch and both payload types. Lower Except ε α to IR result arguments [α, ε], in success/error order.

shapes.meaning: A fixed ordered product of values.
shapes.bounds: Preserve arity, nesting and per-position types; do not infer tuples from arbitrary arrays.

shapes.meaning: A named copied product with declared fields.
shapes.bounds: Preserve every field and mutability rule. A Payload example is not evidence for arbitrary records.

shapes.meaning: A named reference to another semantic type.
shapes.bounds: Resolve aliases without losing constraints, identity or ownership; reject alias cycles.

shapes.meaning: One named constructor with its typed fields.
shapes.bounds: Preserve constructor identity and payloads without exposing Lean constructor numbers.

shapes.meaning: A nominal value retained in the shared runtime.
shapes.bounds: Preserve cross-component identity and explicit disposal; reject stale or foreign resources.

shapes.meaning: A host callable with a declared signature and lifetime.
shapes.bounds: Preserve argument/result types, re-entry, invocation count, self-disposal and errors.
Preserve order, duplicates and nesting with a distinct list constructor. Validate all elements and copying limits; never expose Lean cons cells.
0..0x10FFFF excluding 0xD800..0xDFFF; not one UTF-16 code unit or an arbitrary string.
Bind width to the compiled Lean target, not the consumer process; reject out-of-range values.
Bind signed width to the compiled Lean target and record architecture explicitly.

shapes.meaning: A natural value strictly below a bound.
shapes.bounds: Keep the bound and validate it before erasing proof fields. Fin 0 has no constructible value.

shapes.meaning: A value satisfying a Lean predicate.
shapes.bounds: Generate a checked constructor when validation is executable; require explicit decisions for non-decidable predicates.

shapes.lean: Checked records and closed Nat indices
shapes.meaning: A structure with runtime payload fields and erased proofs, optionally specialized at closed Nat literal indices.
shapes.bounds: Construct inputs only through the selected safe Lean constructor over the exact payload fields. Preserve closed indices and per-site choices; project proof-backed results without fabricating proofs.

shapes.meaning: A runtime type or constraint depends on an earlier value.
shapes.bounds: Preserve the dependency through a checked lowering or a reviewed exclusion; never discard it as an implicit argument.
Bound nesting and allocation; reject host cycles unless the declared identity model supports them.

shapes.meaning: Exports parameterized by types or instances.
shapes.bounds: Deliver checked finite specializations; record open-generic gaps without using an untyped transport.
Separate erased type arguments from implicit runtime values; resolve them from elaborated information.
Specialize or supply the selected dictionary without changing runtime behavior.

shapes.meaning: Proof-only declarations and arguments are erased at runtime.
shapes.bounds: Record theorem identity and assumptions. Erasure does not remove the need to check a runtime refinement.

shapes.meaning: A callable permits an omitted argument.
shapes.bounds: Apply only the declared default; distinguish omitted input from a supplied Option.none.

shapes.meaning: Null from a declared host API.
shapes.bounds: Select an explicit host projection; null does not stand for every missing, erased or unsupported value.

shapes.meaning: A Lean action with IO effects and IO errors.
shapes.bounds: Executing IO is not automatically asynchronous. Preserve effect order and exceptions.

shapes.meaning: An effectful action with a declared error type.
shapes.bounds: Preserve typed failures separately from transport validation and unexpected traps.
Project every declared error and payload; preserve trap or poisoned-runtime handling separately.

shapes.meaning: A computation whose result arrives later.
shapes.bounds: Keep completion, rejection, cancellation and runtime lifetime distinct; do not block a browser event loop.

shapes.meaning: An identity-bearing object owned by the host.
shapes.bounds: Generate typed members and preserve receiver identity, dynamic-access policy and lifetime.

shapes.lean: Lean function returned to the host
shapes.meaning: A retained Lean closure callable through a generated host API.
shapes.bounds: Preserve captured state, call signature, errors and deterministic disposal.

shapes.meaning: A declared request to stop pending work.
shapes.bounds: Specify acknowledgement and late completion; release pending work exactly once.

shapes.meaning: A sequence delivered by explicit pulls.
shapes.bounds: Preserve values, end-of-sequence, failure, early return and cleanup.

shapes.meaning: A sequence whose individual pulls can complete later.
shapes.bounds: Preserve backpressure, pending-pull cancellation and terminal cleanup.

observations.scope: Prepared CPAN archives expose named constructor classes with keyword payloads. Both ordinary-source and independently reviewed builds install offline across all four pinned Perl ABIs, relocate and execute twice without compilers after author and handoff removal. Each execution passes 53,680 assertions over 4,226 calls with 116 rejected inputs and recovery. Isolated compiled XS probes exercise all eighteen constructors, recover from 494 conversion failures and 64 partial-input rejections, preserve four host exceptions, reject seven malformed tags before accessors and handle three reentrant field mutations. All twenty-four installed files retain their hashes through relocation and execution. Independent builds reproduce original archives and installed payloads; Perl installation metadata contains local paths and timestamps.

analysis.note: Prepared Rust crates expose named owned enums with borrowed inputs. Ordinary-source and independently reviewed IR builds pass offline installation with an empty Cargo home, link-only C tool access and a pinned dependency closure. Each public execution passes 4,936 assertions over 4,274 calls; eight invalid consumers fail for their intended Rust diagnostics. Executables run three times, including twice after relocation and source/handoff removal. Two private tests recover from 208 conversion errors and unwinding panics, seven malformed tags and six poisoned inactive cases. Shared real-Lean native probes pass 242 allocation failures, seventy invalid inputs and sanitizer checks with the unchanged 128-byte startup GMP leak baseline.

Plain C and C/GMP archives each pass ordinary-source and independently reviewed IR checks after offline installation, producer/handoff removal and relocation, with two compiler-free executions. Separate native and GMP facade probes exercise 242 and 448 allocation failures respectively; existing output ownership and failure recovery are checked. ASan/UBSan pass; each real-Lean probe retains the unchanged 128-byte startup-only GMP leak baseline.

conversionNotes.list: Consecutive-key PHP arrays preserve empty Lists, order, duplicates and nesting. conversionNotes.list: Consecutive-key PHP arrays preserve empty Lists, order, duplicates and nesting. Element-specific PHPDoc accompanies recursively checked mixed parameters, preventing weak-mode coercion. Results own independent mutable copies. Calls reject associative or sparse arrays, iterator objects, invalid payloads and oversized copies. Typed Lean helpers avoid cons-cell layout assumptions. Native output lengths, missing buffers and alignment are checked before element reads; finally clears owned results after conversion errors.

limitations: Pinned PHP-Wasm 0.1.0, PHP 8.4.1 NTS, Emscripten 3.1.68 and wasm32 in Node and Chromium. Synchronous primitive callables use the main execution context. The pinned host cannot start Fibers; its guard is tested separately in native PHP.
No compound callable, resource, async, copied-field or other-profile promotion. Host functions borrow one call; returned closures own a Zend resource with idempotent close and destructor fallback.

PHP, Zend and native copy budgets each limit conversions to 16 MiB. Brick Math text is limited to 16384 decimal digits. Reentry allows 64 invocations per adapter, with 4096 shared-runtime owned identities. These are not Lean/PHP heap limits.

conversionNotes.unit: Unit is null for arguments and results, including callbacks; a PHP void callback returns null.
conversionNotes.uint32: The 32-bit PHP host requires Brick\Math\BigInteger for the full 0..4294967295 range, even for small values; PHP ints, floats and numeric strings reject.
conversionNotes.int64: Exact Brick\Math\BigInteger preserves both signed 64-bit endpoints on the 32-bit host.
conversionNotes.nat: Exact Brick\Math\BigInteger; negative Nat inputs and callback results reject. No native integer narrowing.
conversionNotes.int: Exact signed Brick\Math\BigInteger including multi-thousand-bit captured values.
conversionNotes.char: One UTF-8 Unicode scalar, including NUL and supplementary values. Malformed text and multiple scalars reject.
conversionNotes.usize: Exact Brick\Math\BigInteger for the 32-bit compiled Lean target, checked in 0..4294967295.
conversionNotes.isize: PHP int for the 32-bit compiled Lean target, checked in -2147483648..2147483647.

observations.scope: Prepared native Composer packages from ordinary source and independent reviewed IR preserve Option, Except and nested binary products, including nineteen primitives, arrays and copied record fields. Weak and strict callers each pass 46123 public assertions three times after offline installation and relocation, without producer sources, handoff archives or compilers. A separate in-memory probe injects 355 conversion failures per path, checks three real cleanup failures, seven malformed outputs and three inactive payloads. Installed files and mapped library hashes remain unchanged. PHP 8.2.33 NTS CLI, Linux x86-64; local glibc floor 2.36, CI 2.38. PHP-Wasm remains unpromoted.

limitations: Native PHP 8.2+ NTS CLI on Linux x86-64 only; PHP-Wasm, FPM and ZTS are not promoted.
Type nesting stops at 32. Validation, PHP conversion and shared native input/output copying each have a 16 MiB accounting limit, not a total-allocation bound.
Copied values cannot contain resources or callbacks. Compound callables, lists, tagged variants and recursive copied types remain separate work.

conversionNotes.option: None is null; new Some($value) retains presence. Some(null) preserves present Unit or an outer Some containing None, according to the declared payload type. Some(Some(null)) preserves two layers. Generated final readonly branch classes expose one value property. Concrete payloads are validated on every call, without weak-caller coercion.

observations.scope: Installed NuGet assemblies built from ordinary source and independent reviewed IR preserve Option, Except and nested binary products, including all nineteen primitives, arrays and copied record fields. limitations: .NET 8 Linux x86-64 native NuGet packages; other platforms are not promoted.

Managed input copying has a 16 MiB accounting budget. Native copying shares a separate 16 MiB budget across inputs and outputs. Type nesting stops at 32; not every managed allocation or Lean working memory is bounded.
Copied values cannot contain resources or callbacks. Compound callable signatures, lists, tagged variants and recursive copied types are not promoted.

conversionNotes.option: Generated readonly record struct with None and Some factories, IsSome/IsNone and guarded Value. `default(Option<T>)` is None; Some(None) and Some(Some(Unit)) remain distinct. Active null reference payloads reject.
conversionNotes.result: Lean `Except E T` uses `Result<T, E>.Ok(value)` or `.Err(error)`. IsOk/IsError select guarded Value/Error. `default(Result<T, E>)` has no branch and rejects at the boundary. Domain errors return Err; bridge failures throw exceptions.
conversionNotes.tuple: Exactly two statically typed C# tuple elements, preserving binary nesting. Inputs are copied; returned arrays own independent storage.

limitations: MRI Ruby 3.3 Linux x86-64 native gems; other platforms are not promoted.
Ruby input accounting and native input/output copies each enforce a 16 MiB budget. Type nesting stops at 32; not every Ruby allocation or Lean working-memory allocation is bounded.
Copied values cannot contain resources or callbacks. Compound callable signatures, lists, tagged variants and recursive copied types are not promoted.

conversionNotes.option: None is nil; Some.new(value) retains presence. Some.new(nil) represents an outer Some of an inner None; Some.new(UNIT) preserves present Unit. Some is a frozen Data class with equality and pattern matching. Concrete payload types are validated at the call; nil is valid only in Option positions.
conversionNotes.result: Lean `Except E T` becomes Ok.new(value) or Err.new(error), both exposing value. Exact branch classes preserve success/error identity, including same-typed payloads. Frozen Data wrappers support equality and patterns. Domain errors return Err; bridge failures raise.
conversionNotes.tuple: Exactly two Array elements, preserving binary nesting and per-position validation. Inputs are copied; returned arrays and strings own independent storage. Branch wrapper fields are frozen, but nested mutable payloads are not. Generated record classes compare fields by value within the same record class.

Input and output conversions share a 16 MiB copied-value budget. Type nesting stops at 32; not every Perl allocation or Lean working-memory allocation is bounded.
Copied values cannot contain resources or callbacks. Compound callable signatures, lists, tagged variants and recursive copied types are not promoted.

conversionNotes.option: None is undef; Some->new(value) retains presence. Some->new(undef) preserves present Unit or an outer Some containing None, according to the declared payload type. Some->new(Some->new(undef)) preserves two layers. Branches are exact generated classes with one mutable value field; subclasses, tied hashes and malformed field sets are rejected.
conversionNotes.result: Lean Except E T becomes Ok->new(value) or Err->new(error), both exposing ->value. Exact classes preserve the success/error branch, including same-typed payloads. Payloads are copied and checked against the concrete Lean type. Domain errors return Err; bridge failures throw.
conversionNotes.tuple: Exactly two dense elements in an unblessed, untied array reference, preserving binary nesting and per-position validation. Inputs and outputs share a 16 MiB copied-value budget. Returned arrays, records, branch payloads and Math::BigInt values are independently owned. Perl reference equality is not deep value equality.

conversionNotes.option: None is undef; Some->new(value) retains presence. Some->new(undef) preserves present Unit or an outer Some containing None, according to the declared payload type. conversionNotes.result: Lean Except E T becomes Ok->new(value) or Err->new(error), both exposing ->value. Exact classes preserve the success/error branch, including same-typed payloads. Payloads are copied and checked against the concrete Lean type. Domain errors return Err; bridge failures throw.
conversionNotes.tuple: Exactly two dense elements in an unblessed, untied array reference, preserving binary nesting and per-position validation. observations.scope: Prepared PHP-Wasm npm and Composer packages from ordinary source and independent reviewed IR preserve Option, Except and nested binary products, including all nineteen primitives, arrays and copied record fields. Each path runs twelve Node/Chromium, embedded/Composer/bundled, startup/lazy and weak/strict arrangements twice, with 46162 assertions per run. Offline installs use empty caches and repeat locked installs; producer, install workspace and archive handoff are removed before compiler-free execution. Installed file hashes remain unchanged and browser requests match deployment bytes. Separate synthetic Zend probes check 19 allocation failures, nine malformed outputs, three inactive payloads and two bailout recoveries in each caller mode. PHP-Wasm 0.1.0, PHP 8.4.1 and Emscripten 3.1.68, wasm32.

conversionNotes.option: None is null; new Some($value) retains presence. Some(null) preserves present Unit or an outer Some containing None, according to the declared payload type. Some(Some(null)) preserves two layers. Generated final readonly branch classes expose one value property. Concrete payloads are validated on every call, without weak-caller coercion.
conversionNotes.result: Lean Except E T becomes new Ok($value) or new Err($error), each exposing a readonly value property. Branch identity is preserved even for same-typed payloads. Domain errors return Err; bridge failures throw. PHP === compares object identity; PHP == property comparison is not generated Lean equality.
conversionNotes.tuple: Exactly two consecutive integer-key array elements preserve binary nesting and per-position validation. Nested arrays, records and branch payloads are copied independently. Validation, host conversion and native copying each have a 16 MiB accounting limit, not a bound on all PHP or Lean allocations. Payloads use the selected target's integer mappings.

observations.scope: Concrete copied WIT variants compile from ordinary source and independently reviewed IR. Nineteen exports, ten families, 281 constructors and two aliases preserve all nineteen primitive payloads, nested values and named field contracts in WIT source, the component binary and manifests. Both paths pass 476,219 assertions across 1,936 calls, including 53 rejection/recovery checks, in each of two relocated compiler-free executions after removing the producer and handoff. An independent rebuild reproduces each original archive and all 68 packaged files. Separate synthetic ASan/LSan/UBSan probes pass 688,008 assertions, 25 allocation failures, input/output budget sweeps, 19 malformed outputs and 22 poisoned inactive payloads with zero tracked live allocations. Synthetic probes are not compiled Lean evidence.

observations.scope: Thirty-five compiler-authenticated array and record exports preserve all nineteen primitives, seven named records and 24 fixed levels of nested arrays. Ordinary and independently reviewed source paths install original CPAN archives offline across four Perl ABIs after removing authors, then relocate and execute twice without producer handoffs or compilers. Each of eight combinations passes 239,954 public assertions across 3,008 calls and 132 rejection/recovery cases. Isolated test-only XS probes pass 1,187 checks, including 1,141 injected conversion failures, 32 partial inputs, eight preserved host exceptions and six reentrant record/outer-array mutations. An independent rebuild reproduces archives, loaded libraries and installed payloads; installation path metadata is excluded from the payload comparison.

conversionNotes.array: Plain unblessed, untied dense array references preserve all nineteen primitive elements, empty arrays, order, duplicates, nested records and independent copied payloads. Input slots are pinned before converters invoke Perl. Calls reject malformed elements, sparse arrays, fixed-schema cycles and over-budget copies, then recover. Weak references do not affect array admission.
conversionNotes.record: Named generated classes preserve field identity, order and meaning, including empty, one-field and nested records. Record constructor keywords keep Perl last-value-wins hash semantics; missing, extra or unnamed fields reject. Calls require the exact class and plain untied hash; subclasses reject. Fields are pinned before converters invoke Perl. Returned records, arrays, octet strings and Math::BigInt payloads own independent copied storage. Perl reference equality is not deep value equality.

Each of eight combinations passes 239,954 public assertions across 3,008 calls and 132 rejection/recovery cases. Isolated test-only XS probes pass 1,187 checks, including 1,141 injected conversion failures, 32 partial inputs, eight preserved host exceptions and six reentrant record/outer-array mutations. An independent rebuild reproduces archives, loaded libraries and installed payloads; installation path metadata is excluded from the payload comparison.

conversionNotes.array: Plain unblessed, untied dense array references preserve all nineteen primitive elements, empty arrays, order, duplicates, nested records and independent copied payloads. Input slots are pinned before converters invoke Perl. Calls reject malformed elements, sparse arrays, fixed-schema cycles and over-budget copies, then recover. Weak references do not affect array admission.
conversionNotes.record: Named generated classes preserve field identity, order and meaning, including empty, one-field and nested records. Record constructor keywords keep Perl last-value-wins hash semantics; missing, extra or unnamed fields reject. Calls require the exact class and plain untied hash; subclasses reject. Fields are pinned before converters invoke Perl. Returned records, arrays, octet strings and Math::BigInt payloads own independent copied storage. Perl reference equality is not deep value equality.

observations.scope: Thirty-five compiler-authenticated exports preserve copied arrays and records through original C/GMP and C++ archives on ordinary-source and independently reviewed paths. The public callers cover all nineteen primitives, seven records and 24 fixed array levels, with independent storage, malformed inputs and budget recovery. An independent rebuild reproduces all original archives, installed files and public observations.

Snapshots preserve bounded local values, not an atomic view of concurrently mutated nested inputs. Frozen wrappers can contain mutable payloads; do not mutate payloads while their containing values are Hash keys.

conversionNotes.array: Exact Array instances preserve every primitive, order, empty and nested arrays and records. Builtin-bound slot snapshots ignore overridden length/index methods. Returned mutable values own independent storage.
conversionNotes.record: Generated keyword-initialized record classes preserve stored field values and nested copies. Records support nominal field-by-field ==, eql?, hash and deconstruct_keys. Objects are frozen; contained arrays and strings remain mutable. C/C++ keyword fields gain a trailing underscore, such as char_.

observations.scope: Thirty-five compiler-authenticated exports preserve copied arrays and records through original Ruby gems on ordinary-source and independently reviewed paths. The public caller covers all nineteen primitives, seven records and 24 fixed Array levels, with independent mutable storage, exact primitive values, malformed inputs, budget recovery and builtin-bound snapshots. Each execution passes 167,545 assertions across 3,225 calls and 118 rejections. A separate in-memory probe checks 842 failure checkpoints, 64 partial invalid inputs and eight malformed output values without changing installed files. An independent rebuild reproduces both original gems, all 24 installed files and every public observation. The publisher and consumer Parcels examples execute from a relocated original gem without Lean or a compiler.

observations.scope: Thirty-five compiler-authenticated exports preserve copied arrays and records through original Cargo packages on ordinary-source and independently reviewed paths. Each public execution checks all nineteen primitives, seven records and 24 fixed Array levels with 321,191 assertions, 3,274 calls and twelve runtime rejections; fifteen invalid callers fail compilation. Separate crate copies exercise 112 host allocation and unwinding checkpoints and 1,546 real-native allocation/panic checks with recovered calls and cleared native outputs. Offline consumers use empty Cargo homes, exact vendored dependencies and a link-only C driver. Original packages remain unchanged. Relocated binaries repeat without sources or compilers, including the documentation example. An independent rebuild reproduces original archives, installed contents, dependencies and public observations.

Fresh primitive, collection, compound, List and variant regressions pass on all four ABIs.

A separate XS probe verifies 22362 injected Perl exceptions, 160 scenarios and four deferred-close cases with no remaining registered owners. Exact consumer documentation and original installed APIs execute twice after relocation and producer-handoff removal. Fresh primitive, collection, compound, List and variant regressions pass on all four ABIs.

observations.scope: Original npm component and runtime archives preserve all nine copied shapes, including recursive values, in callbacks and returned closures on ordinary-source and reviewed-IR paths in Node, strict TypeScript, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit page/React/worker contexts. Each public consumer passes 133120 structured checks, 53 rejection cases and 8084 primitive checks. Archives are verified and relocated; producer sources and builds are deleted before offline, compiler-free installation. Exact consumer documentation executes twice per path. Separate compiled fault probes cover copied-output ownership and shared scalar/structured lifetime limits.

observations.scope: Original native PHP Composer archives preserve all eight acyclic copied shapes in callbacks and returned closures on ordinary-source and reviewed-IR paths. Repeated weak and strict public callers each pass 104399 checks, 2803 calls and 625 expected rejections. Archives and installed packages are verified and relocated; sources, builds and handoffs are removed before compiler-free execution. Exact consumer documentation executes twice per path and Lean compiles the publisher example. Isolated in-memory probes exercise 8080 failures and 15 malformed headers per path, checking scratch and closure cleanup, deferred close and valid recovery. Fresh installed primitive-callable regressions and exact generated-file comparisons retain previous APIs.

Two relocated builds reproduce archives; the producer source and builds are removed before offline installation. Asset-load recovery, React pending unmount and worker disposal are checked.
